messages:
Rina Patel: FYI 11:05 UTC were seeing delayed onboarding callbacks for several Private tenants (webhook 5xx spikes). Affects activations and some trials. I have 8 tenants flagged. Need short customer comms + replay plan. @Tom can you draft a quick note?

Tom Nguyen: Drafting now. Short, empathetic, and actionable.

Tom Nguyen: Hi <Customer>  we detected delays delivering onboarding callbacks for your Private deployment due to an internal webhook delivery issue. Weve applied a fix and expect activations to complete within 3060 minutes. If you need an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and well prioritize you. We will follow up with an RCA and credits where applicable.  Tom, Redwood CS

Arielle Moss: Tone good. Add line: "If your trial expires within 72h, tell us and well pause expiry while we finish replays." Also please include office-hours link.

Samir Bhandari: Tech note: root cause = transient egress proxy overload causing 502/504 to some endpoints. Hotfix pushed (retry/backoff) and were scaling the proxy pool now. Backlog should drain during next 1030min. No data loss; deliveries are idempotent.

ops-bot: [action] scale/egress-proxy replicas 6 -> 16 by Samir Bhandari  job 9981 status=success

Tom Nguyen: Sending first batch to affected tenants now. Message I'll post: ```Hi there  we detected delayed activations for your Private deployment due to webhook delivery failures. Weve applied a fix; activations should finish in 3060 minutes. To request a manual replay reply here or email cs@redwood.com. We will follow up with a technical RCA and any applicable credits.  Tom, Redwood CS```

Arielle Moss: I'll open 30min office hours at 12:00 UTC and prepare a one-question feedback pulse for after resolution. Also creating KB steps for manual replay:

Arielle Moss: ```# Manual replay (CS)
1) POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN"
2) kubectl -n vpc-{tenant} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
3) verify: SELECT status, ts FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Rina Patel: Renewal action: mark tenants with activation >48h or trial expiry <72h as "renewal-watch" and escalate. Tom, please flag CRM notes.

Tom Nguyen: CRM flags added. Actions: Tom send batches (done), Arielle KB + office hours + survey (in progress), Samir full RCA + telemetry (ETA EOD), Rina exec summary + renewal queue handoff.

Samir Bhandari: Replays underway; first confirmations look good. Ill post graphs in RCA doc when ready.
